---
title: "Gambia NFI 2026"
subtitle: "Analysis Report for the \nNFI cycle 2"
#author: "Iveren Chenge, Gael Sola, FAO"
## Report date: on the cover page (bottom) and the report information page, see report/_00-front-matter.qmd
## (no "date" field: pandoc would place it right under the subtitle, above the cover photo)
report-date: "November 2026"
format:
  docx:
    ## Styles in report/reference.docx: A4 portrait, Arial 11, tables and captions Arial 9, captions in italics,
    ## page break before each main section title (Heading 1, also TOC Heading), DRAFT watermark (page header).
    reference-doc: report/reference.docx
    syntax-highlighting: github
    fig-dpi: 300
## Table of contents, list of figures and list of tables are inserted after the foreword, see
## report/_00-front-matter.qmd (pandoc's toc would place them right after the title).
toc: false
toc-depth: 2
#toc-title: "Table des matières"
number-sections: true
bibliography: references.bib
filters:
  ## Table captions in the 'Table Caption' style, needed by the list of tables
  - at: post-render
    path: filters/table-caption-style.lua
  ## Table cells aligned by column (text left, numbers right), column names in bold
  - at: post-render
    path: filters/table-style.lua
  ## Disabled for now. landscape-annex.lua needs a landscape last section in reference.docx (now portrait).
  # - at: post-render
  #   path: filters/landscape-annex.lua
params:
  ## TRUE to run the analysis again, see setup chunk
  run_analysis: false
editor: visual
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: 00-setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)

## Analysis objects: tables (tab), figures (fig) and values quoted in the text (info), saved by the master
## script in 'results/report-objects.rds' (see 'R/07-report-objects.R').
## The master script runs again if the file is missing, if an R script is more recent than the file, or with
## the parameter run_analysis (after a change in the data): quarto render Gambia-NFI-2026-report.qmd -P run_analysis:true
report_file    <- "results/report-objects.rds"
report_scripts <- c("Gambia-NFI-2026-master.R", list.files("R", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))

if (isTRUE(params$run_analysis) || !file.exists(report_file) || any(file.mtime(report_scripts) > file.mtime(report_file))) {
  source("Gambia-NFI-2026-master.R")
}

report_obj <- readRDS(report_file)
tab  <- report_obj$tab
fig  <- report_obj$fig
info <- report_obj$info

## Table formatting functions
source("report/report-functions.R")
```
